sections.sectionTitle: Section A: Basic Economic Concepts and Analysis

subtopics.content: Basic concepts of economics: wants, scarcity, choice, scale of preference, opportunity cost, rationality, production, distribution, and consumption.
subtopics.objective: Compare various economic concepts and their applications; interpret graphs and schedules relating to these concepts; identify economic problems; and propose solutions to economic problems.

subtopics.content: Economic problems: what to produce, how to produce, for whom to produce, and the efficiency of resource use.
subtopics.objective: Identify economic problems, interpret graphs and schedules relating to economic concepts, and propose solutions to economic problems.

subtopics.content: Application of the Production Possibility Frontier (PPF) to the solution of economic problems.
subtopics.objective: Interpret graphs and schedules in relation to economic concepts, identify economic problems, and propose solutions to economic problems.

subtopics.content: Types and characteristics of free enterprise, centrally planned, and mixed economies.
subtopics.objective: Compare the various economic systems, apply knowledge of economic systems to contemporary issues in Nigeria, and propose solutions to economic problems in different economic systems.

subtopics.content: Solutions to economic problems under different economic systems.
subtopics.objective: Compare the various economic systems and propose solutions to economic problems under different systems.

subtopics.content: Contemporary issues in economic systems, including economic reforms such as deregulation, banking sector consolidation, and cash policy reform.
subtopics.objective: Apply knowledge of economic systems to contemporary issues in Nigeria and propose solutions to economic problems.

topics.title: Methods and Tools of Economic Analysis

subtopics.content: Scientific approach to economic analysis: inductive and deductive methods; positive and normative reasoning.
subtopics.objective: Distinguish between the various forms of reasoning and apply these forms of reasoning to real-life situations.

subtopics.content: Basic tools of economic analysis: tables, charts, and graphs.
subtopics.objective: Use tables, charts, and graphs to interpret and analyse economic data and understand the merits and demerits of these tools.

subtopics.content: Measures of central tendency: mean, median, and mode, including their applications.
subtopics.objective: Use measures of central tendency to interpret and analyse economic data and understand their merits and demerits.

subtopics.content: Measures of dispersion: variance, standard deviation, and range, including their applications.
subtopics.objective: Use measures of dispersion to interpret and analyse economic data and understand their merits and demerits.

subtopics.content: Merits and demerits of the tools of economic analysis.
subtopics.objective: Understand and evaluate the merits and demerits of the various tools used in economic analysis.
